rows_audited.lem:GX_atlas_union: isAEAtlas_iUnion: [Nonempty K], each B k an a.e. atlas, any two with a common thinner a.e. atlas (IsThinner matches l.406: supp inclusion, and for p in supp A and every chart of B at p a chart of A at p with smaller source equal to g∘that chart) => the union is an a.e. atlas (IsGXAtlas per connected component of overlaps, support portly). Proof follows the paper's (rigidity on the preconnected W∩supp A, then density/Hausdorff extension). Under DEC-46 (a) this is the paper's statement; N locally connected dropped (weakening); X locally connected/T2 and rigid action are the standing analyticity hypotheses (DEC-39, in the checklist). Necessity of the reading certified by not_isAEAtlas_iUnion_empty. Mark justified, row closed per DEC-46 ('the rows close under these readings').
rows_audited.prop:GX_sing_morph_local: isAEMorphismOf_tfae / isAEMorphism_tfae: TFAE of (i) IsAEMorphismOf, (ii) for all x an open W containing x with IsAEMorphismOn W, (iii) a portly U with IsAEMorphismOn U; IsAEMorphismOn W = some U ⊆ W portly in W (subtype) with IsRegularOn U (f induces a (G,X)-morphism on U into supp B, the target portly set wlog supp B by isAEMorphismOf_iff) — exactly DEC-46 (b). Hypotheses: f continuous (the paper's), M locally connected (singular manifolds are; isAEMorphism_tfae needs nothing beyond the singular structures), A any atlas, B an a.e. atlas (weaker than maximal). IsRegularOn demands U open in M, which for open W coincides with open in W, so not stronger than the reading. Not vacuous. Mark justified.
rows_audited.cor:locally_connected_hausdorff_topologi: aePullback_comp_of_exists: g^*B and f^*(g^*B) defined (maximal a.e. atlases making g, resp. f into g^*B, a.e. morphisms) => f^*g^*B = (g∘f)^*B; aePullback_comp_spec_of_exists shows (g∘f)^*B is then genuinely defined (maximal, making g∘f an a.e. morphism), so the equation is not between the default ∅. 'Defined' as existence is implied by lem:aepullback's hypotheses (existsUnique_aePullback), so the Lean hypothesis is no stronger than the paper's notion of defined; aePullback_comp also gives the form under those hypotheses. B arbitrary (covers a.e. structures under DEC-42), only L locally connected. Matches DEC-46 (c). Mark justified.
